arguments.sql:
SELECT p.id, p.publisher_name, COUNT(h.id) AS tall_hero_count
FROM main.publisher AS p
LEFT JOIN main.superhero AS h ON h.publisher_id = p.id AND h.height_cm > 200
GROUP BY p.id, p.publisher_name
ORDER BY p.id;
